label_hint: Kimi K3.1 Pro: launch, quota reset and open weights
reason: Same model across launch, quota apology and the Nov 5 open-weights release, reported by multiple outlets.

label_hint: Apple brings Alibaba Qwen to Apple Intelligence in China
reason: Same story: Apple and Alibaba announce Qwen powering Apple Intelligence in China (Oct 31), then the China beta rolls out (Nov 4).

label_hint: DeepSeek opens its app toolkit as an API
reason: Same launch: DeepSeek exposes its app's search, file, OCR and voice tools through the API (Nov 13-14), then stops charging separately for model-triggered search and web fetch (Nov 18-19).

label_hint: Microsoft agent-framework PyPI package ships a credential stealer
reason: Same incident: two compromised releases of Microsoft's official agent-framework package on PyPI carried a credential stealer, reported Nov 17-19.

label_hint: Tencent Hunyuan ships Hy4 and Hy4-Flash
reason: One release: Hy4-flash, Hy4-FP8 and Hy4-base weights on Hugging Face (Nov 17-18) plus the Hy4Flash series announcement (224B params, 1M context).

label_hint: Inkling 2 Small: launch to vLLM day-0 support
reason: Announcement to availability: Inkling 2 Small launch coverage (Nov 6) followed by vLLM day-0 serving support for the same model (Nov 12).

label_hint: Qwen 4: teaser to Qwen4-Max preview and benchmarks
reason: Same launch: Alibaba's official Qwen 4 teaser, the Qwen4-Max preview opening in Qwen Chat, then benchmark comparisons showing it trailing Kimi K3.1 Pro.
